title: My Family and Our Jobs
text:
My name is Lucia. I am a doctor. I work in a big hospital in Madrid. I help people when they are sick.

My sister is a teacher. She works at a school near our house. She likes children and books. Every day she reads stories to her students.

options: At a school near their house

questions.text: How does Lucia's sister probably feel about her job?
What kind of person is Lucia most likely?

vocabulary.definition: a place where doctors help sick people
short texts that tell about people or events

paragraph_translations: Me llamo Lucia. Soy doctora. Trabajo en un hospital grande en Madrid. Ayudo a las personas cuando están enfermas.
Mi hermana es profesora. Ella trabaja en una escuela cerca de nuestra casa. A ella le gustan los niños y los libros. Todos los días lee cuentos a sus estudiantes.
